DESCRIPTION: The available generation capacity at the 5 minute and hourly level. The hourly data comes from the ERCOT Short Term Adequacy Report. The 5 minute data comes from the ERCOT Supply & Demand Dashboard. The 5 minute data is comprised of: 1.) the forecasted committed capacity, 2.) current committed capacity that is planning to go off-line but is available to remain on-line, and 3.) additional capacity available to come on-line, if committed at present. The available capacity in each future hour takes into account the start-up time of each generating unit, therefore it typically increases further out in time.
